text: Overview cards: show open-item count per list (both clients)

Done in 8337b10. Open (todo) item count per list on Overview cards, both clients.
Android: ItemDao.openItemCounts() (GROUP BY listId Flow) -> ItemsRepo -> combined
into OverviewViewModel; card shows the count in the primary accent when >0. Web:
derived from the in-memory sync store in OverviewPage. Tests: OverviewViewModel
count excludes checked; full web suite green. Deliberately counted todo only (not
checked/backlog) = "trip pending" items.
